dashboard.label: MISPFuse Overview
dashboard.description: Push Splunk results to MISP. Configure instances, then use the alert action or the mispfusepush command.

ol.li: Open Configuration and add one or more MISP instances (URL + API key).
Or add the alert action MISPFuse - Push to MISP to a saved search.

div.p: Templates live in mispfuse_templates.conf and are validated against your MISP server's describeTypes.

search.query: index=_internal source=*mispfuse* (event OR error OR failed OR success) | table _time log_level message | head 100
